name: perp_template_single_tile_crossing
notes: G1 (offpath campaign, #675). Originally authored to pin the perpendicular-template rung; solved_by attribution (added for the #687 review) proved that rung UNREACHABLE on this shape. Causal chain: on the only single-tile iteration, the item-conflict gate in junction_solver (two items on one boundary tile) skips EVERY strategy and grows the region; the rung then refused any region larger than one tile (ghost_router's tile_count guard). Each gate was correct in isolation; together they made the rung's belt×belt arm dead for two-item crossings — the exact shape it was written for. DELETED 2026-08-22 (#689/#691): the census in junction_seed_census.rs found 0 of 111 seeds across a 12-fixture corpus matched the rung's remaining (single-tile, 2-spec, same-item) hypothesis, and the owner green-lit removing the ~795-line rung (solve_perpendicular_template/try_bridge/bridge_belt_over_pipe/PerpendicularTemplateStrategy) entirely — see docs/offpath-code-followups.md G1. This fixture now pins the PINNED-TIER CORE ladder's dispatch (sat-surface/sat-1ug-native/sat-2ug-native/sat-native — the perpendicular_template rung that used to lead it is gone) on the canonical two-item single-tile crossing (sat-1ug-native solves it on a grown region, bridging the tap under the trunk; auto-tier extras are outside the replay's scope — see README) and stands as the regression record of both the reachability finding and the ladder's post-deletion dispatch: if solved_by ever changes, the core ladder's dispatch on this shape changed. max_cost is padded to 17 over the measured 14 for varisat cost wobble across machines (precedent: electronic_circuit_copper_cable_missing_input_chain's notes); the solved_by pin itself is stable — SAT/UNSAT per rung is deterministic for a fixed formula, only the solution's cost wobbles. The rung's internal pipe×belt logic was pinned separately by perp_template_pipe_belt_bridge.json, deleted alongside the rung (a static unit pin of code that no longer exists) — see docs/offpath-code-followups.md G1.
